messages:
Anna P: Quick check — Launchpad Day0 for SI partners next week. Are lab images preloaded to partner accounts? Need exam windows and proctor list. Also want a 15min pre-bootcamp sync with trainers.
Mike D: Images are built and tagged `launchpad-v1.2-staging`. Uploaded to partner-s3 bucket. I'll push to partner buckets tonight and post confirmation.
Jordan S: Can we add a smoke test script so partners can validate before the session? e.g. `./smoke_test.sh --endpoint https://launchpad.redwood.ai --model test-embed`
Sam T: Trainers need the proctor roster + exam rubric by EOD Friday. Also please include a slide about failure modes & rollback steps.
Anna P: Minimal checklist (to share with SIs):
```
- images delivered to partner bucket
- IAM + console access granted
- smoke tests pass (CI or manual)
- exam windows scheduled and communicated
- proctors assigned with contact info
- trainer prep sync scheduled
- post-run feedback form enabled
```
OpsBot: deploy-bot: partner image push to `partner-s3/launchpad-v1.2-staging` completed (2026-04-12T02:00:00Z).
Mike D: Added checklist to the working doc and linked here: https://redwood.atlassian.net/l/Launchpad-Day0-Checklist (please ping if you can't access)
Sam T: Proposed exam windows: Tue/Wed 9–11am PT and 14–16 CET. Can facilitators cover both? @Jordan S are you available Wed PT to proctor?
Jordan S: I can cover Wed 9–11am PT but not CET. @Mike D can you ask the SI point-of-contact for a local CET proctor or rotate trainers? 
Mike D: Yep, I'll message the SI leads and confirm names + emails. Will update doc when confirmed.
Anna P: I'll schedule a 15min pre-bootcamp sync for Monday (Doodle coming). Thanks everyone — goal is to lock checklist + proctors by EOD Friday. :thumbsup:
